name: Camping Walchensee
beschreibung: Camping Walchensee is situated directly on Lake Walchensee in Tyrol. Renowned for its crystal-clear water, the lake offers wonderful swimming opportunities. The campsite features pitches with scenic lake and mountain views. A lakeside beach area and boat rental are located directly on the grounds. In summer, water sports and fishing are popular pastimes, and the region invites visitors to embark on scenic hikes and bike tours.
